title: Persist trustworthy board approval decision source
classification_rationale: The September 2026 pinned VSM assessment records legitimate parent-board S5 authority. Paperclip issue 18296 and current source show that approval decisions do not retain their authentication source. The assessment informed this scope but did not predict the precise defect.
next_action: Existing decision-source branch is unqualified for S5 until strategic parent-authority capability delta and maintainer predesign are established; preserve code and use source-backed static review. Native tests NOT RUN. No fork-local/external PR before qualification and exact consent.
